_readme: RT1 (2026-11-15): the COMMITTED half of the runtime lane's per-script kill list. runtime_definitions.kill_list()
serves the UNION of these entries and PINE_RUNTIME_KILL_LIST (the variable stays the operator's instant switch).
A listed script falls back OFF the runtime lane at every door (preview, save, served rows, the server lanes),
refused by name with its `reason`. Nothing is deleted: removing an entry brings the script back on the next read.
An entry comes off ONLY when its `liftWhen` is met (an engine fix, then a re-grade to MATCH on the named captures).
tests/test_pine_capability_admission.py holds every entry to its evidence capture (a committed runtime-on verdict
that is not MATCH, on a capture whose source hashes to the entry's sha256). Edit as text.
Lifted: trend-targets-algoalpha (PR #1374), parabolic-sar (2026-11-16, round_to_mintick on a half tick, both captures MATCH).
Empty is a valid state: the by-name rails use a synthetic entry (tests/test_pine_capability_admission.py).
DRAW-1 (2026-11-16): seven scripts newly admitted by obj:box / obj:table have a committed capture grading DIVERGE on
either lane, so each is killed here until its liftWhen (rail: test_DRAW1_every_newly_admitted_object_script_with_a_DIVERGE_capture_is_killed).
